roadmap.title: Passwordless sign-in with magic links
roadmap.goal: Let users sign in with a one-time emailed link instead of a password, without breaking existing password sessions.
decisions: Links expire after 15 minutes and work once.
Password login stays available until the rollout flag is removed.
rules: New behaviour ships behind the `magic_link` flag until the rollout issue closes.
Each PR keeps existing session tests green.

epics.title: Issue and redeem sign-in tokens
epics.summary: Server side: create, email and redeem single-use tokens.
exit: A token can be requested, emailed and redeemed end to end behind the flag.

epics.title: Sign-in screens and rollout
epics.summary: Web screens, rate limits and the staged rollout.
exit: The flag is on for all users and the password fallback still works.

issues.title: Choose the transactional mail provider
issues.summary: Pick the provider the token email will use.
issues.question: Which provider meets our deliverability and cost limits, and what does its API need from us?
issues.hitl_reason: The owner decides on a paid account.

issues.title: Store single-use sign-in tokens
issues.summary: Add the token table and a service that creates, hashes and expires tokens.
acceptance: Tokens are stored hashed and expire after 15 minutes.
A redeemed token cannot be used again.

issues.title: Email a sign-in link on request
issues.summary: POST /auth/magic-link creates a token and emails the link through the chosen provider.
acceptance: Requesting a link for a known address sends one email.
Unknown addresses get the same response and no email.
verify: Manual send to a test inbox

issues.title: Sign in by redeeming a link
issues.summary: GET /auth/magic-link/:token creates a normal session and redirects home.
acceptance: A valid link signs the user in.
Expired or reused links show the retry page.

issues.title: Add the email-link option to the sign-in screen
issues.summary: Users can request a link from the sign-in page behind the flag.
acceptance: With the flag on, the page offers 'Email me a link'.
With the flag off, the page is unchanged.

issues.title: Rate-limit link requests
issues.summary: Limit requests per address and per IP so the endpoint cannot be used to spam inboxes.
acceptance: The sixth request in ten minutes for one address is refused with 429.

issues.title: Roll magic links out to everyone
issues.summary: Turn the flag on in stages and record the result.
issues.hitl_reason: Production flag changes need the owner.
acceptance: The flag is on for all users.
Sign-in error rate stays within the previous week's range.
